headline: 今天的主线：Agent 正在离开写代码的窗口。有的装进了手机，有的在后台自己接活，还有人开始给一群 Agent 做工作台。
headlineEn: Today's thread: agents are leaving the code window. Some moved onto phones, some take on work in the background, and people have started building workbenches for whole fleets of them.

lead.name: morluto/rea
lead.zh: 让 Agent 逆向任何东西，从 App 行为一路看到原生二进制。
lead.en: Lets an agent reverse engineer anything, from app behavior down to native binaries.
lead.why: 今天 GitHub 上一天涨星最多的项目。它的轻量替代 leanrea 和视频版 rea-video 也在榜上，说明这个方向已经开始分化。
lead.whyEn: The biggest one-day star gain on GitHub today. Its lightweight alternative leanrea and video spin-off rea-video are on the list too, so this direction is already branching out.

items.name: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go
items.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进手机：在手机本机跑，也能遥控电脑。
items.en: DeepSeek Harness on your phone: run it on the device or control your computer remotely.

items.name: stablyai/orca
items.zh: 用自己的订阅同时跑一队编程 Agent（Claude Code、Codex 等），桌面、手机都能用。
items.en: Run a fleet of coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex on your own subscription, on desktop or mobile.

items.name: deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype
items.zh: DeepSeek 官方的更自主 Agent 系统原型，10 月 31 日才建的仓库。
items.en: DeepSeek's own prototype of a more autonomous agent system. The repo was only created on October 31.

items.name: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop
items.zh: 让命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、跟进到底，拿不准才发卡片找你拍板。
items.en: Lets a command-line agent pick up work in the background and follow through, and sends a card only when it needs your call.

items.name: Balanov/uncut
items.zh: 只有 7 MB 的无头编程 Agent：一个静态文件，四个工具，不偷偷截断上下文。
items.en: A 7 MB headless coding agent: one static file, four tools, and no silent context truncation.

items.name: crystl
items.zh: 为编程 Agent 做的 macOS 多任务终端。
items.en: A multitasking terminal for coding agents on macOS.

items.name: OpenVisio
items.zh: 团队和编程 Agent 共用的一个工作区。
items.en: One workspace shared by your team and its coding agents.

items.name: Pressure
items.zh: 想听第二种意见？让两个 Agent 就你的问题辩论。
items.en: Want a second opinion? Have two agents debate your question.

items.name: mattpocock/skills
items.zh: 「给真正工程师的 Skills」，作者直接公开自己 .agents 目录。
items.en: "Skills for real engineers": the author publishes their own .agents directory.

items.name: heydamir/unslop
items.zh: 一个 Claude Skill，把一眼 AI 味的界面改成像设计过的样子。
items.en: A Claude skill that turns an obviously AI-made interface into something that looks designed.

items.name: garrytan/gstack
items.zh: Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置：23 个工具，分别扮演 CEO、设计、工程经理、发布和 QA。
items.en: Garry Tan's Claude Code setup: 23 tools acting as CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager and QA.

items.name: anthropics/skills
items.zh: Anthropic 官方的 Agent Skills 公开仓库，想写自己的 Skill 可以从这里看起。
items.en: Anthropic's public repository of Agent Skills, a good place to start before writing your own.

items.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.zh: 跨会话保留上下文：记下 Agent 做过的事，压缩后在下次会话注入。
items.en: Keeps context across sessions: records what the agent did, compresses it and feeds it into the next session.

items.name: tang1693/KIKUmap
items.zh: macOS 菜单栏小工具，把 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的聊天画成思维导图。
items.en: A macOS menu bar tool that draws your Claude and ChatGPT chats as a mind map.

items.name: OrgSync
items.zh: 给 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Codex 团队共用的公司知识库。
items.en: A shared company knowledge base for teams on Claude, ChatGPT and Codex.

items.name: Cloptima
items.zh: AI 网关、护栏和 LLM 成本管理。
items.en: An AI gateway with guardrails and LLM cost management.

items.name: Tencent Hy4
items.zh: 腾讯旗舰模型，新增看图和操作电脑的能力。
items.en: Tencent's flagship model, now able to read images and operate a computer.

items.name: ChatGPT Images 2.6
items.zh: 支持 GIF 和可复用的参考图，生成速度快 50%。
items.en: Adds GIFs and reusable reference images, and generates 50% faster.

items.name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
items.zh: 英伟达的语音转写模型，用 Speech LLM 做智能转录。
items.en: NVIDIA's speech transcription model, using a Speech LLM for smarter transcripts.
